description: Independent root verification (see tools/root_verifier.py for the recompute logic).

resource_name.description: WZRD protocol resource (deposit/claim/settle etc.) for auto-detection and seq hints.
resource_name.title: Resource Name

root_seq.description: Specific root sequence to verify. If omitted, best-effort resolution via resource metadata or latest.
root_seq.title: Root Seq

seller_wallet.description: Seller wallet for WZRD protocol resource detection.
seller_wallet.title: Seller Wallet

name: verify_root_inputs

error.description: Error message on the ERROR path; null on PASS/FAIL.
error.title: Error

leaf_count.description: Number of leaves (users) in the verified root.
leaf_count.title: Leaf Count

leaf_hash_match.description: True iff every server-provided leaf_hash matches the locally recomputed value.
leaf_hash_match.title: Leaf Hash Match

onchain_match.description: Always null: this tool does NOT read Solana/the AO program. Use server_consistent for the recompute result; do not gate on-chain actions on this field expecting a chain anchor.
onchain_match.title: Onchain Match

recomputed_root.description: Independently recomputed sorted-pair keccak256 merkle root (hex).
recomputed_root.title: Recomputed Root

root_seq.description: Root sequence number that was verified.
root_seq.title: Root Seq

server_consistent.description: True iff the recomputed root/dataset_hash matches the value the SERVER published alongside its own leaves (self-consistency). NOT an on-chain check. Null when not comparable.
server_consistent.title: Server Consistent

status.description: "PASS" = recomputed GLOBAL_V5 leaves + dataset_hash + sorted-pair root match the published values. "FAIL" = mismatch (do not trust the root). "ERROR" = could not run (fetch failure / missing data).
status.title: Status
